name: Heavy Duty Plastic Mouse Trap | Reusable Mouse Catcher | Best Quality Rodent Trap
description:
The Heavy Duty Plastic Mouse Trap is designed for effective, safe, and hygienic rodent control. Made from durable ABS plastic, this reusable trap offers a one-touch setup, high sensitivity, and quick action—ensuring mice are caught instantly without mess, blood, or suffering. Its no-poison, no-glue, no-touch design makes it safer and cleaner to use compared to traditional wooden traps. Washable, long-lasting, and suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, this mouse trap ensures a rodent-free environment with minimal effort.Key Features:
 One-touch easy setup—no risk of snapping fingers
 No poison, no glue, no-touch mouse disposal
 High-sensitivity trigger for fast and humane catch
 Strong ABS plastic construction, reusable over 10+ times
 Washable, odor-free, and long-lasting
 Suitable for indoor and outdoor rodent controlHow to Use:
1⃣ Place bait such as peanut butter, cereal, or nuts inside the trap
2⃣ Press the tail end of the trap until it locks
3⃣ Position the trap where mice frequently appear
4⃣ Remove caught mouse without touching
5⃣ Wash and reuse as neededIngredients / Materials:
High-quality ABS plastic, stainless-steel springSafety Information:
 Keep away from children, pets, and the elderly
 Avoid placing near food preparation areas
 Do not insert fingers inside the trap
 Use only recommended baits for best results
